signature: On bell garland: “MACHT ANTONI SCHNITZER A[NNO] MCLXXI [master’s mark: three triangles in a shield]” on mp: "NURMB"; Mark of Schnitzer family on mp and bell;¹  on lower slide stay, angel playing lute.²
mouthpiece: Rare example of surviving mouthpiece from same workshop as instrument, based on maker’s mark and signature “NURMB” on mouthpiece. ⁵
dimensions: bo 10, be 100, le 2700, thickness of metal ca. 0.35.⁴  Mouthpiece: outside diameter of rim 30 ; inside diameter of rim 22, depth of cup 7m tghroat 7, diameter of exit from stem 9, total length 72, length of stem 50 (including rings below cup).

remarks: Flat slide-stays with removable clasps, ornamented with legless dragons; upper stay has hole in center.⁶  Tuning slide, slide stockings.
